title: RNAseq T24 Rep1
growth_protocol_ch1: RPMI, 10% fetal bovine serum, 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin. Cells were cultured at 37C at 5% CO2.
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA Extraction using Zymo RNA MiniPrep Kit followed by library preparation | NEBNExt Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina (Catalog# E7420, NEB)
data_processing: Samples were aligned to the hg38 with reference annotation GENCODE v39 using STAR (2.7.0). | Only uniquely mapped reads without duplicates were selected usign samtools (version 1.10) | Read counts were assigned to genes using Subread featureCounts. | Assembly: GRCh38/hg38 | Supplementary files format and content: Tab delimited files containing gene names and featurecounts
contact_institute: Keck School of Medicine of USC
